title: Thousands demonstrate across Turkey against violence against women
seoTitle: Istanbul march against violence against women

tea.why: Protesters gathered to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women and oppose rising femicide rates.
tea.want: Effective investigations into suspicious deaths, enforcement of Law No. 6284, and state protection against gender-based violence.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Thousands demonstrated in cities including Istanbul, Ankara, and Diyarbakır despite local bans and heavy police presence.

summary: On November 25, 2026, thousands of people held demonstrations across Turkey to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women. In Istanbul, approximately 3,000 protesters gathered under heavy police presence after authorities banned a planned march at Taksim Square. Similar rallies occurred in Ankara, Diyarbakır, Izmir, and other locations. Organised by various feminist groups and political figures, including representatives from the DEM Party, the protests highlighted the high number of femicides in the country. Participants criticized the government's 2021 withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and demanded more effective judicial investigations into suspicious female deaths. Protesters also called for budget allocations to prioritize social welfare over military spending. Authorities maintained a strong police blockade throughout the events, citing security concerns and official bans on specific gathering sites.
demands: Effective investigations into suspicious female deaths
Prioritization of social welfare over military spending
response: Authorities banned gatherings at Taksim Square in Istanbul and deployed heavy police forces to monitor and restrict the demonstrations across multiple cities.

crowd.text: Approximately 3,000 people participated in the Istanbul demonstration.

updates.text: Thousands gathered in cities across Turkey to protest violence against women on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.
Police blocked access to Taksim Square in Istanbul, leading to a demonstration held under heavy security.
